📉 Double Top Chart Pattern — How to Trade It

What is a Double Top?

A Double Top is a bearish reversal pattern that forms after an uptrend.
Price creates two highs at nearly the same level, showing buyers failed to push higher twice → sellers gain control.

Structure of the Pattern

1 Uptrend – Price is moving higher.
2 First Top – Price rejects from resistance.
3 Pullback – Price drops to a support level (this becomes the   neckline).
4 Second Top – Price retests resistance but fails again.
5 Break of Neckline – Confirmation of the pattern.

✅ How to Take Entry

Best Entry Method (Safe Entry)

Wait for price to break and close below the neckline.
Then wait for a retest of the neckline (previous support becomes resistance).

Enter SELL / SHORT on rejection from this level.

📌 Aggressive Entry:
Sell immediately on strong breakout candle below neckline (higher risk).

🛑 Where to Put Stop Loss (SL)

Place Stop Loss:
Above the second Last Candel Before Breakout (safest)
OR
Just above the retest zone / resistance area.
Reason: If price goes above the second last candel , the pattern is invalid.

🎯 Where to Set Take Profit (TP)

Measured Move Method (Most Reliable)

Measure distance from:
Top → Neckline

Project the same distance downward from the neckline break.
This projected level is your main TP.

You can also scale partial profits:

TP1: Previous low / structure support
TP2: Full measured move

📌 Quick Trading Rules

Pattern forms    	Two equal highs after uptrend
Confirmation  	Neckline break
Entry	                Sell on retest of neckline
Stop Loss       	Above second top
Take Profit	Height of pattern projected down

⚠️ Important Tips

Works best near strong resistance levels
Use with:
RSI divergence
Volume decrease on second top
Bearish confirmation candle (engulfing, rejection wick)
Higher timeframes = more reliable

Summary

Double Top signals trend reversal from bullish to bearish.
Entry    After neckline break + retest
SL        Above second peak
TP        Distance from peak to neckline measured downward

 اشترت شركة BitMine 69822 إيثريوم الأسبوع الماضي، مما زاد إجمالي حيازاتها إلى 3.63 مليون إيثريوم.تخطط الشركة لبدء تخزين أصولها في أوائل عام 2026.يواجه الإيثريوم ضغوطًا بالقرب من 3000 دولار بعد استعادة دعم 2850 دولار.
زادت شركة BitMine، التي تدير خزينة الإيثريوم، من حيازاتها من الإيثريوم الأسبوع الماضي.
استحوذت الشركة المدرجة في ناسداك على 69822 إيثريوم، مما زاد إجمالي حيازاتها إلى 3.63 مليون إيثريوم، وفقًا لبيان يوم الاثنين بيان. تمثل هذه الأرقام 3% من إجمالي تداول الإيثريوم، مما يقرب BitMine من هدفها الأصلي المتمثل في الاحتفاظ بـ 5% من إمدادات الإيثريوم.
كما حافظت الشركة التي تتخذ من نيفادا مقرًا لها على رصيد قدره 192 بيتكوين (BTC)، واستثمار بقيمة 38 مليون دولار في خزينة Worldcoin (WLD)، و 800 مليون دولار نقدًا غير مقيد.
مع انخفاض أسعار العملات المشفرة على مدى الأسابيع القليلة الماضية، انخفضت قيمة إجمالي أصولها إلى 11.2 مليار دولار. تحتفظ الشركة بخسارة غير محققة تزيد عن 3.4 مليار دولار عبر خزينة الإيثريوم، وفقًا لبيانات CryptoQuant.
قال توماس لي، رئيس BitMine: "يعكس الانخفاض المستمر في أسعار العملات المشفرة في الأسبوع الماضي السيولة المتضررة منذ 10 أكتوبر، بالإضافة إلى الجوانب الفنية للأسعار، التي لا تزال ضعيفة". "قبل بضعة أسابيع، لاحظنا أن الانخفاض المحتمل لأسعار الإيثريوم سيكون حوالي 2500 دولار، والأسعار الحالية للإيثريوم هي في الأساس هناك. وهذا يعني وجود مخاطر/عائد غير متكافئ حيث أن الانخفاض هو 5% إلى 7%، بينما الارتفاع هو الدورة الفائقة المقبلة للإيثريوم."
BitMine ستبدأ في تخزين حيازاتها من الخزينة
سلطت BitMine الضوء على أنها ستبدأ في تخزين حيازاتها من الإيثريوم في عام 2026 باستخدام شبكة المدققين المصنوعة في أمريكا (MAVAN)، والتي تدعي أنها ستكون "أفضل حل في فئته يقدم بنية تحتية للتخزين."
يمكن أن تساعد هذه الخطوة في تعزيز متوسط تكلفة حيازاتها من الإيثريوم.
تدعي BitMine أنها تحتل المرتبة 50 بين أكثر الأسهم تداولًا في الولايات المتحدة، مع متوسط حجم تداول يبلغ 1.6 مليار دولار، خلف Mastercard وأمام Palo Alto Networks.
تظل الشركة رقم 1 في خزينة الإيثريوم على مستوى العالم، تليها SharpLink Gaming وThe Ether Machine بحيازات تبلغ 859395 إيثريوم و496712 إيثريوم، على التوالي، وفقًا لبيانات SER.
ارتفعت أسهم BitMine بنسبة 19.6% يوم الاثنين، مما قلل من انخفاضها الشهري إلى 42.1%.
توقعات سعر الإيثريوم: الإيثريوم يستعيد دعم 2850 دولار ولكنه يواجه ضغوطًا بالقرب من 3000 دولار
سجل الإيثريوم 74 مليون دولار في عمليات التصفية خلال الـ 24 ساعة الماضية، بقيادة 53.17 مليون دولار في عمليات تصفية قصيرة، وفقًا لبيانات Coinglass.
استعاد الإيثريوم مستوى 2850 دولار بعد انخفاضه دونه في نهاية الأسبوع الماضي. تشير الاستعادة إلى أن الحيتان وعناوين التجميع دافعت عن متوسط تكلفة حيازاتها، والتي تقع ضمن نطاق 2800-2900 دولار.

title: 狗狗币ETF震撼上线！从零到220亿市值、互联网梗冲击华尔街！
subTitle:
如果你以为狗狗币（#DOGE ）只是网络笑话，那美国市场最近的动作可能会让你彻底改观——首个现货狗狗币ETF正式上线！#加密市场观察 

这不仅是加密货币领域的里程碑，也标志着“幽默梗”正在悄悄走进主流金融市场。与此同时，DOGE价格的反弹却显露出一些阻力，告诉我们，即使笑话成真，市场依然有自己的节奏。
狗狗币ETF：从表情包到金融产品🎯
回顾狗狗币的诞生，它本是一场互联网的恶搞：一只柴犬、Comic Sans字体和小费文化。但十年来，这只“笑话狗”不仅没有消失，反而成为互联网文化的一部分。Reddit、Twitter等社交平台推动了其爆发式传播，而埃隆·马斯克的高调表态则让价格经历了戏剧性的波动。

如今，狗狗币首次被纳入美国现货ETF市场，与比特币（#BTC ）、以太坊（#ETH ）等蓝筹加密货币平起平坐。所谓现货ETF，是指直接持有实际资产，而非期货或合成篮子。这意味着投资者可以以更直接、更透明的方式持有DOGE——从网络玩笑到合规资产，狗狗币完成了一次惊人的“进化”✨。
正如分析师指出的那样，这次ETF的推出意义远超狗狗币本身：它证明幽默、投机和创新可以合法共存，而金融市场正在逐渐接受文化驱动型资产的价值。
而与此同时，狗狗币仍然是市值排名第九的加密货币，截至撰写本文时，其市值为 220 亿美元。

模因币时代：文化就是价值🌐
不仅是狗狗币，柴犬币（SHIB）市值 46 亿美元，Pepe（PEPE）市值 17.5 亿美元……模因币正在形成一股不可忽视的市场力量。ETF 上市只是表象，更深层次是：市场开始认可文化驱动的资产价值。幽默、社群和投机不再只是“网络笑话”，而是可以创造金融价值的真正力量。

当然，波动性仍在。模因币价格一天内可能涨跌 10–20%，监管也在逐步跟进。巨鲸抛售、市场情绪变化，都可能让价格上演惊险一幕。但正是这种不确定性，让这个阶段的投资既刺激又充满话题性。
市场表现：反弹受阻📉
尽管ETF带来里程碑式的意义，狗狗币价格却显现出技术性挑战。DOGE从0.1330美元起步反弹，一度突破0.140美元和0.1420美元，但在0.1530-0.1540美元附近遇到明显阻力。

支撑位：0.1460美元、0.1420美元，若跌破0.1330美元，短期内可能探至0.120美元甚至0.1120美元。阻力位：0.1540美元和0.1590美元，突破后或上探0.1650美元甚至0.1720美元。技术指标：MACD动能有所减弱，RSI仍高于50，显示多头仍有空间，但反弹势头略显疲软。
换句话说，ETF的利好消息并不能立即让价格飞天，投资者仍需关注市场波动和短期技术走势。
总结：市场正在学会“对笑话认真”🎯
幽默、投机、创新和风险交织，形成了一种独特的投资哲学：如果一个笑话都能持续十年，还能流传于全球数以百万计的社群，我们又怎能低估它的潜力？

狗狗币ETF的上市，是互联网文化走向主流金融的标志；DOGE价格的短期反弹受阻，则提醒投资者：市场始终有自己的节奏。
ETF和技术面结合告诉我们两件事：
互联网文化能影响主流金融市场——从社交媒体到 ETF，文化价值正在转化为金融价值。幽默、投机和创新可以共存——即使是源自网络梗的资产，也能被合法化、规范化，并创造新机会。
所以，下次看到那只柴犬笑容可掬时，别忘了，它背后可能正在推动金融市场的一次“尾巴摇摆革命”🐾。

title: A Proposal for a Major Update to Solana (SOL) Has Been Submitted – Here’s What’s Coming
subTitle:
The Solana (SOL) ecosystem has opened discussion on a significant governance proposal that could reshape the network’s inflationary structure.
The proposal, codenamed SIMD-0411, aims to double the current annual inflation rate by increasing it from -15% to -30%. If implemented, Solana's inflation rate would rise from 4.18% today to reach the long-term target of 1.5% in early 2029 rather than 2032. This would reduce the time it takes to reach the final inflation rate from 6.2 years to 3.1 years.
According to modeling, the proposal would prevent approximately 22.3 million SOL from being issued over the next six years. This amount is equivalent to approximately $2.9 billion at current prices. Long-term investor retention is expected to increase due to the decline in total supply, reduced pressure on staking returns, and a weakening trend toward token sales. 
Increasing the rate of inflation decline will also gradually reduce staking returns. Under the proposal, nominal staking returns will decrease from 6.41% to 5.04% in the first year, 3.48% in the second year, and 2.42% in the third. The impact on the validator economy is expected to be limited: only 10 of the 845 validators are expected to lose profitability in the first year, rising to 27 in the second year and 47 in the third year.
Proponents of the proposal cite the approach's greatest advantages as “simplicity and predictability.” They argue that because only a single protocol parameter needs to be changed, the risk is low, core developer resources won't be consumed, and the change is easily understandable by both individual investors and institutions. They also point out that, unlike dynamic inflation models, future supply can be clearly calculated.
The Solana ( $SOL ) community is currently discussing SIMD-0411 within the governance framework. If approved, the proposal is expected to be deployed in approximately six months, depending on network updates and the governance process.

title: Мы тоже верим в рост цены ETH. И Bitmine приобрела дополнительно ETH на сумму $82,11 млн.
subTitle:
Когда крупные структуры продолжают накапливать актив на просадках, это само по себе становится частью рынка и его нарратива. Свежий пример — дополнительная покупка 28 625 ETH на сумму около $82,11 млн со стороны Bitmine, зафиксированная по ончейн-данным и подтвержденная рядом новостных сводок. На таком фоне фраза «мы тоже верим в рост цены ETH» перестает быть абстрактным оптимизмом и превращается в позицию, подкрепленную действиями реальных игроков, готовых добавлять риск на миллионы долларов в момент, когда рынок еще не выглядит однозначно «бычьим».

Важно и то, что эта покупка не стала разовой вспышкой. По доступным данным, Bitmine последовательно наращивает позицию в $ETH , доводя суммарные объемы до миллионов монет и формируя один из крупнейших казначейских портфелей в экосистеме. При этом значительная часть этих монет находится в нереализованном минусе относительно текущих цен, но стратегия не меняется: вместо фиксации убытка идет докупка. Для нас это сигнал о долгосрочном взгляде: такую линию поведения сложно объяснить попыткой «поймать короткий отскок», она больше похожа на ставку на то, что через несколько лет текущие уровни будут казаться лишь очередным этажом внизу графика.
{future}(ETHUSDT)

Рынок уже начал реагировать на эту активность. После очередного эпизода покупок мы видим заметный рост оборотов по #ETH  и попытки цены закрепиться в важном диапазоне, где сейчас идет борьба между теми, кто воспринимает новости как повод наращивать позиции, и теми, кто использует любое усиление спроса для разгрузки. Одновременно на ончейн-карте видна интересная картина: одни крупные участники агрессивно докупают эфир, другие, напротив, выводят части своих резервов на сторонние площадки. Это типичная ситуация для фаз, когда рынок балансирует между страхом и жадностью, а локальная волатильность маскирует зарождающийся тренд.

На этом фоне наш собственный взгляд предельно прост: мы тоже верим в рост цены ETH, но воспринимаем такие покупки не как сигнал «залетать на все», а как важный маркер перераспределения капитала в пользу эфира на средне- и долгосрочном горизонте. Крупные докупки на десятки миллионов не гарантируют ровную прямую вверх, рынок по-прежнему способен на резкие откаты и болезненные коррекции. Однако они показывают, где именно формируется доверие к активу в момент общей неопределенности. И если вы смотрите на ETH не с горизонтом одного дня, а в логике лет, подобные шаги больших игроков становятся тем фоном, на котором гораздо легче выстраивать свою собственную, аккуратную и дисциплинированную стратегию.
#Ethereum #long

#ETH  Last year, someone came to me, and their account had only 2900U left. They said they wanted to try again, just wanting to turn things around.

I didn’t give them hope or myths; I just told them to honestly follow the model, straighten out the rhythm, control the positions, and manage the losses strictly.

In the first two months, they hardly made any money, like they were treading water.
Every day two or three trades, cutting losses when they hit the mark, going to cash directly when the market didn't align.
What they found most difficult wasn't losing money, but “enduring” — enduring not to add positions, enduring not to chase rises, enduring not to bet on reversals.

But it was this slow pace, the seemingly unchanging slowness, that suddenly started to accelerate in the third month.

🔥The Brutally Simple Crypto Mindset 
Forget the complex charts. Here is the simple, powerful mantra that has fueled fortunes.  
Buy when there's fear. When the news is doom and gloom, when prices are crashing, and everyone else is panicking and selling their holdings, that is your signal. True wealth is accumulated by acquiring assets for cheap from people who have lost their nerve. Be greedy when others are fearful.
Sell when it's trending. When your asset is soaring, when every mainstream outlet is talking about it, and your neighbor who never invested before is asking how to buy in—that's the time to take profit. The peak of enthusiasm is usually the peak of the price. Be fearful when others are greedy. 
Repeat until you are rich. Consistency and discipline are everything. Don't fall in love with a coin; stick to the strategy. Over time, following this counter-intuitive approach allows you to capture profit from market highs and capitalize on corrections. 
This simple framework matters today, in late 2025, because the crypto market is entering a new phase of maturity where these emotional cycles are becoming faster and more pronounced. With recent regulatory clarity in various regions and the increased participation of institutional investors, the swings between extreme fear and extreme greed are amplified. Understanding this core psychological rhythm is crucial for anyone looking to navigate the next major bull run and the subsequent inevitable corrections without being emotionally ruined. The simple approach provides a mental anchor in an otherwise volatile environment.

Crypto Market Prediction: $1.4 Billion Bitcoin (BTC) Carnage Ends — But Ethereum (ETH) Crash May Not Be Over Yet

The crypto market has entered one of its most turbulent phases in months. Bitcoin is slowing after a brutal multi-billion-dollar liquidation cascade, Ethereum’s decline is intensifying, and Shiba Inu appears to be carving out a temporary bottom. While some assets show signs of stabilization, others remain in deep trouble.

Bitcoin: The $1.4B Bloodbath Finally Easing

{spot}(BTCUSDT)

Bitcoin appears to have survived the worst of a $1.4 billion liquidation wipeout that hammered both institutional and retail traders. After a relentless drop from the $110,000 zone into the mid-$80,000s, BTC has finally shown its first legitimate sign of seller exhaustion.

Here’s what changed:

Oversold recovery: $BTC  snapped back sharply after becoming deeply oversold.Sell volume declining: Aggressive sell pressure is fading for the first time since the downtrend began.Long lower wicks: Buyers are visibly defending the lows — a classic early stabilization signal.

Bitcoin sliced straight through the 20-, 50-, and 100-day moving averages, and every intraday bounce was crushed instantly. But now the market is entering a decision zone.

Key Range to Hold: $83,000–$85,000

If BTC maintains support here:

A gradual grind upward becomes the base case.Price typically heads back to retest major moving averages in the $96,000–$105,000 range.First comes the 20-day MA retest, then the 50-day — not a sudden V-shape, but a slow reclaim.

The biggest risk is a secondary retest of the lows.

If the retest shows lower volume and holds the floor, BTC forms a classic bottom structure.

Break the floor, however, and Bitcoin likely dips back into the mid-$70,000s.

For now, the market appears to have flushed out the panic sellers — and the $1.4 billion liquidation event may have been the reset BTC needed.

Ethereum: No Bottom Signal Yet — And That’s a Problem

{spot}(ETHUSDT)
While Bitcoin and Shiba Inu are showing bottom-forming characteristics, Ethereum is not — and that divergence is worrying.

Here’s what Ethereum is missing:

No rounding bottomNo stabilization curveNo decisive rebound candleNo sign that buyers are absorbing supple

ETH’s chart still looks like a straight-line decline, not even pausing to flatten. That’s the first major red flag.

Ethereum fell below every major moving average — 20-, 50-, 100-, and even the 200-day — yet failed to produce the strong snap-back you expect at a bottom. The RSI went oversold, but the reaction was weak and shallow.

Why ETH’s Setup Is Dangerous

Instead of curling back toward moving averages, $ETH is sliding under them. This often triggers:

Panic selling from trapped longsA second leg down that can be sharper than the first

Until Ethereum forms structure — higher lows, stronger bounce candles, curvature on the chart — the downtrend remains fully intact.

Shiba Inu: Quiet Signs of Stabilization

{spot}(SHIBUSDT)

Shiba Inu is showing its first constructive signs after weeks of intense sell pressure.

Key signals:

Rounding stabilization near the lows — a slow curve that often precedes bottoming.Oversold RSI bounce — one of the lowest readings of the year.Lack of follow-through selling — sellers appear to be tirings

Instead of falling below the critical $0.0000075 zone, $SHIB  is curving upward slightly — enough to suggest waning bearish strength.

Levels That Matter

Support: $0.0000075–$0.0000080Short-term resistance: Recover the 20-day MAyUpside targets: $0.0000092 – $0.0000100Major breakout zone: $0.0000105 – $0.0000110

Only a breakout above that long-term declining trendline confirms a transition from stabilization into true recovery.
Bottom Line

Bitcoin may have completed its capitulation — stabilization is emerging, but confirmation requires holding $83K–$85K.Ethereum remains structurally weak with no bottom signal yet — the downtrend could continue.Shiba Inu is quietly forming early bottoming signs but needs to reclaim moving averages to confirm a reversal.

title: Ethereum Outlook
subTitle:
Ethereum is approaching a critical point as it trades near major support levels around $2,700. Weak ETF inflows, softer investor sentiment, and rising competition from other blockchains are weighing on ETH, putting pressure on its ability to regain bullish momentum.
Market Overview
Ethereum has slipped toward the $2,400–$2,500 support range—one of its most important zones in over a year. Analysts view this area as pivotal: holding it could set up a move back toward $4,000, while losing it may trigger a deeper 30–40% correction. ETH is currently down about 40% from its 2024 peak of $4,500.
ETF Inflows Show Mixed Signals
Institutional inflows into U.S. Ethereum ETFs remain weak compared to Bitcoin. ETH ETFs have attracted just $1.2 billion year-to-date versus Bitcoin’s $18 billion. While inflows recently stabilized—ending a nine-day outflow streak—momentum remains inconsistent, reflecting cautious institutional sentiment.
Key Technical Levels
Critical support: $2,400–$2,500 (historical demand, high-volume node, multi-month range low).Immediate resistance: $2,800, aligned with the 20-day EMA and a horizontal supply zone.Bearish risk: A breakdown below support could extend losses to $2,300, $2,150, or even $1,890.Bullish path: A strong rebound and a close above $2,800 may open targets at $2,880, $3,000, and eventually $3,500–$4,000.
Indicators like RSI and MACD show early stabilization, while rising funding rates signal optimism from leveraged traders—but higher spot volume is needed to confirm strength.
Broader Factors Pressuring ETH
Ethereum continues to face competition from faster L1 networks like Solana, while L2 fragmentation adds complexity to its ecosystem. The validator count has dropped from 1.1 million to about 950,000, raising questions about network participation and security. Still, Ethereum remains the dominant platform for DeFi, staking, and developer activity.
Fundamental Strength Remains Intact
Despite short-term weakness, core fundamentals are supportive:
The Dencun upgrade has significantly reduced L2 fees and increased activity.High staking participation (25%+ of supply) helps reduce sell pressure.Growing ETH-backed lending options increase liquidity.Layer-2 usage continues to boost ETH burn rates, improving long-term scarcity.
Possible Price Scenarios
Downside: Losing the $2,400–$2,500 support may push ETH to $2,150 or even $1,890 during broader market weakness.
Upside: A rebound could drive a recovery to $2,800–$3,000, with a potential move toward $4,000 if volume and institutional demand increase.
Outlook
Analysts maintain cautious optimism heading into 2025. Continued L2 expansion, better ETF flows, and upcoming network upgrades could support recovery. However, ETH still faces risks from macroeconomic conditions, regulatory uncertainty, and rising competition from other chains.
Overall, Ethereum sits at a “make-or-break” moment—its ability to defend key support will determine whether it regains momentum or enters a deeper corrective phase.

#ETH  Don't gamble everything! The truth about making a comeback with small funds is just a few points.

Recently, I've seen too many brothers rushing in, thinking that with a few hundred U or a few thousand U, they can strike it big. That expression on their faces, like 'If I don't double my money today, I don't deserve myself,' makes me sweat for them.

So what happens?

They can't grasp the direction, can't keep up with the rhythm; one moment they're going all in on long positions, the next moment on short ones. Their accounts haven't turned around yet, but their emotions have already crashed back and forth three times.

I understand this mindset because I used to be like that.

I thought as long as luck was on my side, just one trade would take off. But reality slapped me twice, making me realize — bankruptcy is never because you're stupid, but because you're too anxious.

You really can't rush with small funds.

It's not for gambling your life away; it's for compounding, nurturing, and establishing fundamental logic.

You see me stable now because I was educated harshly by the market back then.

Once, I also had a few hundred U, thinking I could gamble everything to change my fate. But in less than ten minutes, I failed to change my fate and ended up 'changing my life' instead.

Later, I realized that what small funds need the most is — to survive.

It's not about passion; it's about rhythm;

It's not about gambling; it's about waiting;

It's not about forcing it; it's about knowing when to evade.

If you stick to rolling small profits, earning profits, even if you only take a tiny bit each day, over time, the numbers will exceed your imagination.

Stop dreaming about that overnight wealth scenario; that's for others to see, not for you to play with.

The small funds that truly can turn around rely not on luck, but on patience, stability, and execution.

If you absorb this, you can change your fate; if you don’t, well… you’ll understand sooner or later, but you might have to pay some 'tuition.'

If you're confused, not sure how to roll or control the rhythm, don't force it.

Just ask Jia Ge, and I’ll guide you on the right path, helping you avoid the pitfalls I encountered back then.

title: ETH приближается к $3000. Неужели будут сложности со взятием этого уровня, когда многие пророчили $5
subTitle:
Когда цена $ETH снова подбирается к зоне в районе $3000, в ленте сразу всплывают старые скриншоты с прогнозами про $5000 и выше. На эмоциональном уровне кажется: если рынок уже видел такие цели в аналитических трендах, то пройти $3000 должно быть делом техники. Но рынок не обязан исполнять ничьи ожидания. Сейчас уровень $3000 для ETH — это не просто красивая цифра, а зона, где сходятся интересы тех, кто покупал на просадках, и тех, кто хочет зафиксировать прибыль после долгого периода неопределенности.
Сложность пробоя этого уровня связана не только с самим $ETH , но и с фоном: глобальной ликвидностью, ставками, аппетитом к риску и настроением на крипто-рынке в целом. Для части участников $3000 становится психологическим барьером: кто-то воспринимает его как «нормальную» справедливую цену, кто-то как удобную точку выхода после долгой стагнации. В результате в этой зоне усиливается давление продавцов, и любой негативный новостной фон или падение объемов способно превратить красивый рывок в очередной откат.
{future}(ETHUSDT)
Вторая причина — структура спроса. В предыдущие циклы рост ETH поддерживали не только спекуляции, но и реальный спрос со стороны DeFi, NFT и активных ончейн-юзкейсов. Сейчас рынок более трезвый: инвесторы смотрят на комиссии, конкуренцию со стороны L2 и альтернативных сетей, динамику обновлений и реальный доход инфраструктуры. То есть просто «сделать цену» уже недостаточно — рынку нужен понятный драйвер, почему именно сейчас ETH должен не просто протестировать $3000, а закрепиться выше и продолжить путь к тем самым $5000.
И все же сам по себе факт подхода к $3000 — это не тупик, а проверка на зрелость. Если ETH сможет пройти эту зону не на коротком всплеске, а на фоне растущей активности, постепенного притока капитала и интереса долгосрочных игроков, то цели в районе $5000 перестанут выглядеть чистой фантазией. Но важно не путать прогнозы с обязательствами рынка. Цифра $3000 сегодня — это скорее экзамен на устойчивость и качество спроса, чем магический порог, после которого начнется автоматический «разгон к луне».

title: Ethereum has once again proven its resilience, fiercely defending the crucial $2,850 support zone as
subTitle:
In a move that stunned the market last week, BitMine Immersion Technologies—the Nasdaq-listed giant responsible for managing Ethereum’s largest corporate treasury—expanded its already-massive ETH holdings with an additional 69,822 ETH. This latest acquisition pushed its treasury to 3.63 million ETH, representing an astonishing 3% of all Ethereum in circulation, and bringing the company ever closer to its long-stated ambition of commanding 5% of the entire ETH supply.
Beyond Ethereum, BitMine’s balance sheet reflects the scale of a global powerhouse: 192 BTC, a sizable $38 million Worldcoin treasury position, stakes in Eightco Holdings, and nearly $800 million in uncommitted cash reserves. Even so, the prolonged downturn in digital asset prices has dragged the value of its full portfolio to $11.2 billion, while its ETH holdings alone are carrying an unrealized loss exceeding $3.4 billion, according to CryptoQuant data.
Chairman Thomas Lee addressed the ongoing market weakness with a surprisingly candid statement, noting that liquidity had been thin since October 10 and that broader technical indicators remained fragile. Yet his view on Ethereum’s long-term trajectory remains unapologetically bullish. He reiterated that BitMine had previously forecast a potential downside to the $2,500 region, and now that ETH is hovering just above that level, the imbalance between risk and reward is shifting dramatically in favor of long-term accumulation. In his words, a mere 5–7% downside stands against what he calls “the supercycle ahead for Ethereum.”
BitMine also confirmed that it will begin staking its monumental ETH treasury in early 2026 through the Made in America Validator Network (MAVAN), an infrastructure solution the company describes as best-in-class. This strategic move not only strengthens the security and decentralization of the network, but also positions BitMine to steadily lower its average cost basis through validator rewards over the years.
Despite a turbulent market, BitMine maintains its status as one of America’s most actively traded equities—currently ranked 50th in the nation, with an average daily trading volume surpassing $1.6 billion, placing it ahead of tech leaders like Palo Alto Networks.
Industry data from SER further reinforces BitMine’s dominant standing, confirming it as the single largest corporate Ethereum holder on the planet, followed by SharpLink Gaming with 859,395 ETH and The Ether Machine with 496,712 ETH.
Markets reacted sharply to the latest developments. BitMine’s stock surged 19.6% on Monday, trimming its monthly decline to 42.1%, while Ethereum experienced $74 million in liquidations over the past day—$53 million of which came from aggressive short positions being forced out at a loss, per Coinglass.
Ethereum’s price structure remains tense but technically intriguing. After dipping below $2,850, the asset rebounded with force, signaling that whales and high-conviction accumulators stepped in to defend their established cost basis, which lies between $2,800 and $2,900. Still, ETH continues to face notable headwinds: price action has repeatedly rejected at the $3,000 psychological barrier, while the $3,100 zone—supported by the 20-day EMA—remains a formidable resistance band.
If the $2,850 floor fails to hold on the next retest, Ethereum could be exposed to a deeper decline toward the $2,300 region, a level many analysts warn would be structurally damaging. Technical oscillators are offering mixed signals: both the RSI and Stochastic Oscillator have rebounded from oversold zones, yet remain below their equilibrium marks, indicating that bearish momentum is fading—but far from gone.
As the market waits for clarity, one thing is undeniable: institutional giants are accumulating, liquidity is shifting, and Ethereum is quietly preparing for its next decisive chapter.

SWIFT the backbone of international banking has officially launched its 2025 cross-border payments pilot.
And the tech they chose to build on?

Linea an Ethereum Layer-2 from ConsenSys.

Not XRP.
Not any “payments-first” token.
Ethereum L2.

And they’re doing it alongside 30+ major banks, including heavyweights like JPMorgan, HSBC, and BNP Paribas. 🤯

🚨 What This Signals

Big finance isn’t chasing hype cycles anymore they’re adopting tech that’s proven, scalable, and already integrated into institutional frameworks.

For the XRP community…
this is a serious reality check. The long-held idea that XRP would be the global payments standard just met a real competitor and this time, it’s backed by the banks themselves.

⚙️ Why Ethereum’s Linea Was Chosen

When institutions build infrastructure, they choose what works today not what might work someday.

Linea brings:

High throughput ⚡

Low-cost transactions

Tooling and infrastructure banks can use right away

The credibility of the broader Ethereum ecosystem

This isn’t a test run in a sandbox.
It’s the beginning of deployment-level adoption.

🤷‍♂️ And Where Does That Leave XRP?

That’s the million-dollar question.

Is XRP slipping into the “old model” category while Ethereum evolves into the default settlement layer?
Or can XRP still innovate fast enough to stay relevant in the payments arena?

The competition just got real.

Global money rails are being rebuilt right now.
If these major banks start settling transactions through Ethereum L2 infrastructure, the downstream impact will be massive:

Payments

Market structure

These types of changes start quietly…
but the opportunities usually follow fast.
